item.text: [{"task_id":"278e5215","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    foreground = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    palette_row = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    fill_row = int(round(params['rule'][3]))","    step = int(round(params['rule'][4]))","    if foreground == background or step <= 0:","        return grid.copy()","    points = np.argwhere(grid == foreground)","    legend_points = np.argwhere((grid != background) & (grid != foreground))","    if len(points) == 0 or len(legend_points) == 0:","        return grid.copy()","    top, left = np.min(points, axis=0)","    bottom, right = np.max(points, axis=0)","    legend_top, legend_left = np.min(legend_points, axis=0)","    legend_bottom, legend_right = np.max(legend_points, axis=0)","    mask = grid[top:bottom + step, left:right + step]","    legend = grid[legend_top:legend_bottom + step, legend_left:legend_right + step]","    if palette_row < 0 or fill_row < 0 or palette_row >= legend.shape[0] or fill_row >= legend.shape[0]:","        return grid.copy()","    palette = legend[palette_row]","    if len(palette) != mask.shape[1]:","        return grid.copy()","    fill = legend[fill_row, 0]","    return np.where(mask == foreground, palette, fill).astype(int)"],"shapes":{"rule":[5]},"params":{"rule":[0,5,0,2,1]},"rationale":"Crop the gray pattern.
